summary_1line: Krishna consoles grieving Yudhishthira by recounting many legendary kings whose immense power and virtue could not save them from death.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna gently takes the grief-stricken Yudhishthira’s sandal-anointed hand as the assembled warriors watch in silence.
The infant Mandhatri lies on his father’s lap while Indra offers his finger, from which a stream of milk flows into the child’s mouth.
Rivers glitter with golden tortoises, crabs, and fishes during King Suhotra’s reign after Indra showers gold upon the land.
